form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Severity
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stops stepping at the next record where the selected element produced a message of this severity or higher: INFO, WARN, ERROR or FATAL. Leave blank to turn this condition off.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stops at the next record with a message this severe or worse. Blank turns it off.

form:FormGroup.label: Output
form:FormGroup.helpText: Stops stepping at the next record where the output of the selected element is empty or not empty. Leave blank to turn this condition off.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stops at the next record with empty or not empty output. Blank turns it off.

form:FormGroup.label: Stepping Conditions
form:FormGroup.helpText: XPath filters applied to the output of the selected element. Stepping stops at the next record where any filter matches. Use the toolbar buttons to add, edit or delete filters.
